title: I Put $10,000 Into 5 Stocks During This Selloff. Here’s Why
creator: Couch Investor
summary: Couch Investor reviews a bruising week in which his cash portfolio fell 11.6% against the S&P 500's roughly 2% fall, argues the selloff is not justified, and walks through buy zones ahead of a heavy earnings week — Netflix on Tuesday 20 October and Meta on Wednesday, alongside Tesla, IBM, Lam Research and Texas Instruments. He notes 84% of S&P names are already at least 10% below their highs and, with the index near 20x forward earnings, rejects the dotcom-bubble comparison. He discloses putting $10,000 into five stocks during the selloff and details four explicit buys: AVGO — BUY at about $328, position up 10%, buy zone $315–335; RKLB — BUY at about $50, raised by 3.7% (plus an earlier 25 shares at $61–62), despite Neutron testing now running into early 2027 and a possible Q2 2027 launch; AXON — BUY at $409, position up 15%, back at its original entry floor after a round trip to $600; and NBIS — BUY at about $165, bought twice in 10-share lots above the current price, buy zone $160–172, which he calls best-in-class and a future $100B+ company. Other names are buy-zone commentary only: GOOGL $330–342, SOFI, AMZN about $250, META $660–690, CRWV about $61 and AMD $510–540. A Peter Lynch clip on having the stomach for corrections closes the video. NBIS flips CONDITIONAL_BUY to BUY; the others reiterate prior BUYs.
